name: Iceland
notes: Iceland is in the European Economic Area. Under the EEA Agreement, Directive 2004/38/EC on free movement applies with 'Union citizen(s)' read as 'national(s) of EC Member States and EFTA States' (EEA Joint Committee Decision No 158/2007), so Icelandic nationals can enter every EU country on a valid passport or national ID card, with no visa, and stay up to 3 months without formalities. Within EFTA, the EFTA Convention lets nationals of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland enter each other's territory 'simply upon production of a valid identity card or passport', with no entry visa (Annex K, Appendix 1, Art. 1). The 90/180-day rule doesn't apply: the Schengen Borders Code treats people with free-movement rights under agreements with the Union separately (Art. 2(5)(b)).
